set.body:
Goal: complete the platform-independent half of the differential court without pretending it is vendor EDF proof.

Acceptance criteria:
- A typed comparator reports fixture, left/right source operands, field path, expected, actual, and an explicit exact or named numeric tolerance.
- All portable corpus fixtures produce canonical eyes4s facts and available independent ASC-reference facts; absent EDF API evidence remains an explicit unsupported/missing oracle result.
- Metamorphic checks cover LF/CRLF changes, legal whitespace changes, arbitrary byte repartitioning, sample/event conversion subsets, GAZE translation with matching frame translation, and independent block concatenation.
- Exact fields never use epsilon; any numeric tolerance is a named value with units and rationale.
- Unsupported transformations/configurations fail as typed unsupported results, not passing comparisons.
- A deterministic machine-readable portable-conformance summary is packaged for the eventual release validation artifact.
- Comparator and metamorphic mutants are demonstrated to fail on JVM and Scala.js where portable.
set.title: Build the portable EyeLink differential and metamorphic court
